summary: Single-thumb range input with built-in label, supporting text and error text.

usage.text: The value, min, max and step attributes are strings. The value is clamped to the range and snapped to the step whenever any of them changes, so read it back after setting it.
The required attribute has no effect on validity. Only the invalid attribute makes it invalid, and the error text (default "Please choose a valid value.") is shown only while invalid is set.
The show-ticks attribute draws marks only when the range divides into 2 to 50 steps.

a11y.text: The value-text attribute becomes aria-valuetext. Set it when the number alone is not meaningful, for example "Medium".
